channel.title: Tech Now
channel.desc: Shiona McCallum meets the mums and hospital staff trialling the first new assisted birth innovation in decades. Yasmin Morgan-Griffiths visits a company building sustainable electric vehicle tech, which doesn't rely on rare earths. Ammie Sekhon meets the comedian who has created an AI of himself to see if it's better at comedy than he is. And Lara Lewington finds out why Kew Wakehurst botanic garden has become a living laboratory.
